---
title: "Penguin Explorer"
---

Explore the relationship between penguin bill length and body mass using the
Palmer Penguins dataset.

This is a learning project following Alex K. Gold's
[DevOps for Data Science](https://do4ds.com/).

## Current progress

The local labs for Chapters 1 through 4 are complete:

- R and Python use project-specific environments with recorded dependencies.
- The EDA and model reports read a shared DuckDB database.
- A saved model is served through a local Vetiver prediction API.
- A Shiny interface requests predictions and logs successes, diagnostic details,
  and request failures.

Use the navigation to explore the R EDA and Python model reports. The interactive
prediction interface requires the separate Shiny and API servers to be running;
startup commands and project progress are documented in the repository README.

Rebuilding and publishing this Quarto website through GitHub Actions is the next
chapter's task.
